name: AMOS AI document scanning and Amy assistant
summary: AMOS 25.12 adds AI-supported document scanning to speed receiving and quotations; Swiss-AS also demos an AI assistant called Amy.
paragraphs: AMOS 25.12 adds AI-supported document scanning to speed receiving and quotations; Swiss-AS also demos an AI assistant called Amy.
whyItMatters: For stores already on AMOS, AI capture of receiving paperwork means less hand-keying and cleaner stock data.
